name: @avatark/narrative-runtime
description: Generic runtime that executes authored narrative definitions (seasons/episodes/scenes/beats/choices/triggers) -- data-driven and franchise-agnostic. Contains no Krishna, Rama, Adhi Yogi, Prometheus, or other franchise content; StudioK authors the definitions this package executes.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
